info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts professional judgement matrices API
Submit new professional judgement matrix configuration

items.docs: Submit new professional judgement matrix configuration. In the response, a unique identifier `pjmId` for the configuration will be returned. The identifier can be used to retrieve the configuration at any time in the future.

params.name: pjmId
params.description: Unique identifier of a professional judgement matrix configuration

items.docs: Get a specific professional judgement matrix configuration. The configuration is identified by the value in the `pjmId` parameter. This ID was returned in the response when the configuration was created.

params.name: pjmId
params.description: Unique identifier of a professional judgement matrix configuration
